subject: swampTroll
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: swamp troll with tusks, mohawk and bone fetishes.
Style: Blizzard/Warcraft.
reasoning:
I'm planning a compact but detailed jungle troll design—tall hunched frame, blue-teal skin, pointed ears, tusks, mohawk, loincloth and bone fetishes—then starting to build out the skeleton structure for it.

Working through the leg and arm limb chains with bends and lengths, plus hands with clawed fingers, torso geometry using bones for the loft...

Still building head details...

Planning the mohawk blades to lean backward with a red-orange gradient, then adding tusks and jaw geometry from bone material, and finally sketching fetish details like a tooth necklace and trophy skull.

Now I'm designing the shoulder pauldron with bone spikes and a skull-and-jaw trophy, plus feather cards using svg textures. I'm also planning the loincloth as an extruded panel with a tribal stripe pattern, and starting to loft the hunched torso stations with increasing width and height going up the body.

Continuing the build down to the neck sweep and bone-scaled shoulder spheres for the hunch, then shaping the tapering legs into boxy feet with clawed toe spikes sized to sit flush at ground level. Now I'm adding a tribal war-paint decal on the chest using an svg tattoo mark.

Working out the glow treatment for the eyes and decal textures, then sketching hands as simple clawed spheres off the wrist bone and toe claws as spikes off the ankle, plus ear shapes extruded near the head for the mohawk bone setup.
